detail.longDescription: I’m genuinely curious on perspectives here. My hunch is some of the answers might imply the existential risk to humanity is not quite what it seems. My hypothesis is that you need both verifiability and a domain-native semantic model/self-contained symbolic universe. Those conditions don’t hold for a lot of human activity. I think the corollary to this hypothesis is whether semantic model construction itself is verifiable, in which many more domains will start to look like coding and math.
